items.prompt: A customer messages a support line asking where their parcel is. Which reply fits best?
options: Parcel located. Status: in transit. Delivery: Thursday. No action required.
Good news, your parcel's on its way and should arrive Thursday!
items.target: Parcel located. Status: in transit. Delivery: Thursday. No action required.

items.prompt: A user tells a voice assistant to set an alarm for seven. Which reply fits best?
options: Alarm set for 07:00. Awaiting your next instruction. Standing by.
You got it! Your alarm's set for seven, so rise and shine!
items.target: Alarm set for 07:00. Awaiting your next instruction. Standing by.

items.prompt: A guest at a hotel desk says their room key has stopped working. Which reply fits best?
options: Oh, I'm so sorry about that! Here's a new key for you.
Key card invalid. Replacement issued. Room access restored.
items.target: Key card invalid. Replacement issued. Room access restored.

items.prompt: A colleague asks whether the report went out. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, it went out this morning. Thanks so much for asking.
Affirmative. Report transmitted at 09:00. Task closed.
items.target: Affirmative. Report transmitted at 09:00. Task closed.

items.prompt: A friend asks if you can come to dinner on Friday. Which reply fits best?
options: Friday dinner: available. Arrival time 19:00. Attendance logged.
Friday works for me! I'll be there around seven, can't wait.
items.target: Friday dinner: available. Arrival time 19:00. Attendance logged.

items.prompt: A caller asks a pharmacy assistant when their prescription will be ready. Which reply fits best?
options: So sorry for the wait! It'll be ready by three, I promise you.
Prescription in preparation. Collection time: 15:00. Bring identification.
items.target: Prescription in preparation. Collection time: 15:00. Bring identification.

items.prompt: A passenger asks the train announcer why the train has stopped. Which reply fits best?
options: Signal fault ahead. Train held. Departure expected in ten minutes.
Hi folks, small signal problem ahead, moving again in ten minutes.
items.target: Signal fault ahead. Train held. Departure expected in ten minutes.

items.prompt: A student asks a tutoring app whether their answer is right. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes! Spot on, brilliant work, you nailed it!
Answer correct. Score updated. Load next question.
items.target: Answer correct. Score updated. Load next question.

items.prompt: Someone at the door asks if this is the Patel household. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, this is the Patels' house. How can I help you today?
Affirmative. Patel household. State the purpose of your visit.
items.target: Affirmative. Patel household. State the purpose of your visit.

items.prompt: A child asks their parent if they can have a biscuit. Which reply fits best?
options: Permission granted. One biscuit. No further biscuits.
Go on then, just the one, and save me a bite!
items.target: Permission granted. One biscuit. No further biscuits.

items.prompt: A customer asks a café whether they still have oat milk. Which reply fits best?
options: Oat milk: in stock. Quantity sufficient. State your order.
We sure do! Loads of it, so what can I get for you?
items.target: Oat milk: in stock. Quantity sufficient. State your order.

items.prompt: A user asks a chatbot to cancel a subscription. Which reply fits best?
options: We're sorry to see you go! Your subscription is now cancelled.
Cancellation processed. Subscription terminated. No further charges.
items.target: Cancellation processed. Subscription terminated. No further charges.

items.prompt: A neighbour asks if you saw who took in their parcel. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, the courier left it with flat three around ten past two.
Courier delivered at 14:10. Recipient: flat three. Logged.
items.target: Courier delivered at 14:10. Recipient: flat three. Logged.

items.prompt: Your manager asks how the server migration went. Which reply fits best?
options: Migration executed. All services operational. Zero errors recorded.
Smooth as anything! Everything's moved over and running great!
items.target: Migration executed. All services operational. Zero errors recorded.

items.prompt: A visitor asks a museum guide where the toilets are. Which reply fits best?
options: Toilets: ground floor, east corridor, second door. Proceed.
Just down on the ground floor, second door on the east side!
items.target: Toilets: ground floor, east corridor, second door. Proceed.

items.prompt: A friend asks whether you got home safely last night. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, home safe and sound, thanks so much for asking!
Affirmative. Arrived home at 23:40. Status: safe.
items.target: Affirmative. Arrived home at 23:40. Status: safe.
